title: The Injury
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael burns his foot on a George Foreman Grill but insists on coming to work despite his injury, refusing help from Dwight. Dwight crashes his car while trying to pick up Michael and suffers a head injury requiring a hospital visit and a CAT scan. Michael holds a meeting about disabilities and creates a homemade bubble wrap cast for his foot. Throughout the episode, tensions and humorous interactions arise among Michael, Dwight, Pam, and others as they navigate the challenges of the injuries and hospital visit.
